    model_config = {'extra': 'ignore'}

    f.write\('TEST_BOOL=true\\n'\)
    tmp = f.name

os.environ['TEST_BOOL'] = 'true'
s2 = S\(\)
print\(f'from env: test_bool={s2.test_bool}'\)

os.unlink\(tmp\)
